title: The disciples thought they were about to die.
paragraphs: The disciples thought they were about to die.

Waves crashing.
Wind screaming.
The boat filling with water.

In their panic they cried out,
“Teacher, don’t you care if we drown?”
And with three words everything changed:

The wind stopped.
The waves obeyed.
The storm bowed.

And the same Jesus
who calmed that sea
is in your boat today.

Your storm may be loud.
But His authority is louder.
You are not facing this alone.

If you’re in a storm right now, remember:
The presence of Jesus in your boat changes everything.
🙏 Comment PEACE if you believe God is with you in this storm.
